evidence.detail: The skin loads the exact resource RuneLite.colorschemes and resolves many named schemes such as RuneLite Active, RuneLite Enabled, RuneLite Border, RuneLite Header Border and RuneLite Header Watermark.
The class directly extends SubstanceSkin and configures color-scheme bundles, borders, marks, separators, title/header decoration areas, tab fades and overlay painters.
The class extends Substance ClassicButtonShaper and overrides getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float).
getCornerRadius always returns 0.0f for every button and size, forcing square button corners.
The shaper stores only its synthetic RuneLiteSubstanceSkin parent reference and has no unrelated styling behavior.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the zero-corner-radius button shaper used by the RuneLite skin.

evidence.detail: The class directly extends SubstanceLookAndFeel and its constructor delegates with a newly-created rs/gui/b skin instance.
rs/gui/b is the exact RuneLite-branded SubstanceSkin, making rs/gui/a the concrete LookAndFeel wrapper for that skin.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the Substance LookAndFeel wrapper around the RuneLite skin.
